spot_vij_1.name: Kanaka Durga Temple
spot_vij_1.shortDescription: Sacred temple situated on the Indrakeeladri hill overlooking Krishna river.
spot_vij_1.history: Dating back to the 8th century, the Kanaka Durga Temple is mentioned in ancient scriptures. Arjuna is believed to have obtained the Pasupatastra here after praying to Lord Shiva.

spot_vij_2.name: Undavalli Caves
spot_vij_2.shortDescription: Monolithic rock-cut cave temples dating back to 4th-5th century AD.
spot_vij_2.history: Built by Vishnukundina kings, these sandstone caves feature a giant 5-meter long reclining statue of Lord Vishnu carved out of a single block of granite.

spot_vij_3.name: Prakasam Barrage
spot_vij_3.shortDescription: Iconic 1224-meter bridge structure lit beautifully over Krishna River at night.
spot_vij_3.history: Constructed in 1957 across Krishna River, it forms a vast lake reservoir and supplies irrigation water while serving as Vijayawada's signature skyline backdrop.

spot_vij_4.name: Bhavani Island
spot_vij_4.shortDescription: One of the largest river islands in India with water sports and eco-resorts.
spot_vij_4.history: Spanning 133 acres in the Krishna River, Bhavani Island offers tranquil boat rides, lush gardens, rope courses, and heritage puppet shows.

spot_hyd_1.name: Charminar
spot_hyd_1.shortDescription: Global icon of Hyderabad built in 1591 with 4 ornate grand minarets.
spot_hyd_1.history: Constructed by Sultan Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah to commemorate the eradication of a devastating plague, standing at the heart of historic Old City.

spot_hyd_2.name: Golconda Fort
spot_hyd_2.shortDescription: Magnificent citadel famous for acoustic engineering and Koh-i-Noor history.
spot_hyd_2.history: Originally built by Kakatiya Dynasty and later expanded by Qutb Shahi kings. Famous for hand-clap acoustics echoing from entrance gate to top palace acoustic dome 1km away.
spot_hyd_2.operatingHours: 9:00 AM - 5:30 PM (Sound & Light show at 6:30 PM)

spot_hyd_3.name: Chowmahalla Palace
spot_hyd_3.shortDescription: Opulent palace of the Nizams featuring grand courtyards and vintage cars.
spot_hyd_3.history: The official seat of the Asaf Jahi dynasty, modeled after the Shah's palace in Tehran, housing imperial throne rooms and crystal chandeliers.
